name: GeoJS
tagline: Free IP geolocation and country lookup for browsers and CDNs
description: GeoJS is a lightweight, free IP geolocation service that returns country and location data as JSON or JSONP. Designed for browser and CDN use without API keys, it is popular for simple client-side geo lookups and content localization.

auth.details: No authentication required; public endpoints accept unauthenticated GET requests.

use_cases: look up country and city for a visitor IP
detect client country in the browser without an API key
localize content or currency by IP geolocation
enrich server logs with geo metadata for an IP
